feature_notes:
Usable editing performance improvement: fixed 64 KiB buffering batches preserved XML fragments before ZIP compression. A one-million-numeric-cell existing A1 edit/save is measured at 7.0485 s on alpha.2 versus 1.3450 s on alpha.3 (5.24x), with byte-identical uncompressed package parts and public full readback. Output ZIP shrinks from 3,868,674 to 3,156,360 bytes; median peak RSS rises from 2,540 to 2,684 KiB.

Buffers fit the existing operation working reserve. Explicit flushes propagate deferred output errors. No worksheet spool is added; atomic path output still requires a complete temporary ZIP. Global formula-cache invalidation, XML/CRC validation and original assets are preserved. Rust 1.88 and latest stable tests pass; full structural editing and M2 remain open. See benchmarks/alpha3-edit-buffering.md and ADR 0048. Python scalar conversion improvements are published separately in the adapter.
